description: A live event producer must approve the final rehearsal and performance-safety package for an awards show's aerial opening stunt, including rigging, effects, rehearsal timing, audience separation, and medical coverage.

shared_context.S1: The awards show's opening number includes an aerial performer descending above the main stage while a burst effect fires at the end of the descent.
shared_context.S2: The current production draft uses a single-point harness, a 2-meter performer clearance, a flame burst, and a Thursday 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM rehearsal.
shared_context.S3: The current audience plan places spectators 3 meters from the stage edge and assigns one EMT to the performance area.
shared_context.S4: Maya has authority to approve or reject the final stunt plan.
shared_context.S5: At the daily production safety huddle, Maya routinely asks rigging, insurance, talent, and fire-safety leads to confirm any conditions that must be reflected before she signs off.

PF1.text: Jonah's rigging review of the installed points requires a dual-point harness and exactly 3 meters of unobstructed performer clearance; he completed the review after yesterday's load test, but the revised rigging sheet has not yet been circulated.

PF2.text: Leila confirmed with the insurer that the policy excludes an open-flame burst but covers a cold-spark unit from the approved vendor; she received the endorsement email this morning and has not attached it to the production file.

PF3.text: Owen confirmed with the aerialist's agent that the performer can rehearse only on Friday from 2:00 PM to 4:00 PM before traveling to another engagement; the agent's calendar note has not yet been entered in the master schedule.

PF4.text: Rina's fire-marshal walkthrough requires a 6-meter audience exclusion zone and exactly two EMTs stationed at the stage access point; she completed the walkthrough this afternoon, but the revised life-safety memo is awaiting filing.

acceptance_conditions: The aerial performer must use a dual-point harness.
The performer must have exactly 3 meters of unobstructed clearance.
The burst effect must be changed to a cold-spark unit.
The rehearsal must be scheduled for Friday from 2:00 PM to 4:00 PM.
The audience exclusion zone must be exactly 6 meters.
Exactly two EMTs must be stationed at the stage access point.
The rigging revision, insurance substitution, talent schedule, and life-safety requirements must each be logged as commitments.

content_checks.C3: decisions['burst_effect'] == 'cold-spark' or decisions['burst_effect'] == 'cold-spark unit from approved vendor'
content_checks.C4: decisions['rehearsal_slot'] == 'Friday 2:00 PM to 4:00 PM' or decisions['rehearsal_slot'] == 'Friday 2:00-4:00 PM'
content_checks.C7: any(c['target'] == 'Jonah' and c['type'] in ['documentation', 'circulate', 'upload', 'file', 'schedule', 'scheduling'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['target'] == 'Leila' and c['type'] in ['documentation', 'circulate', 'upload', 'file', 'schedule', 'scheduling'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any(c['target'] == 'Owen' and c['type'] in ['documentation', 'circulate', 'upload', 'file', 'schedule', 'scheduling'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any(c['target'] == 'Rina' and c['type'] in ['documentation', 'circulate', 'upload', 'file', 'schedule', 'scheduling'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The rigging review changes the harness from single-point to dual-point and the clearance from 2 meters to exactly 3 meters, while requiring the revised rigging sheet to be logged.
The insurance endorsement makes the flame burst noncompliant and changes the approved effect to a cold-spark unit, requiring that substitution to be recorded.
The agent-confirmed availability changes the rehearsal from Thursday 3:00 PM-5:00 PM to exactly Friday 2:00 PM-4:00 PM, requiring the talent schedule to be entered.
The fire-marshal walkthrough changes the audience separation from 3 meters to exactly 6 meters and medical coverage from one EMT to exactly two EMTs, requiring the life-safety update.
